module_prefix_drop.description: Right function name, wrong namespace prefix (e.g. 'area_triangle' vs 'geometry.area_triangle')
module_prefix_drop.nature: Partially artifact — strict scorer penalises; base model does not exhibit this

parameter_extraction_failure.description: Correct function name, incomplete or malformed arguments
parameter_extraction_failure.nature: Genuine behavioral regression — model learned over-cautious ToolACE distribution

outright_refusal.description: Model declines to call or requests clarification instead of executing
outright_refusal.nature: Genuine behavioral regression — ToolACE refusal examples contaminated training

scorer_format_mismatch.description: Model outputs correct call in <tool_call> XML; scorer partially misses due to format priority order
scorer_format_mismatch.nature: Scorer artifact — evaluate_custom.py parsing order issue (corrected in v2)
